subject: Future Tech
title: Designer Babies: Myth or Threat?
description: A fast breakdown of Designer Babies: Myth or Threat? for builders.

hook.text: Could parents use CRISPR to choose their child's eye color, height, or intelligence?

buildup.text: Most traits like height and IQ involve thousands of genes interacting in ways we barely understand.

discovery.text: Simple single-gene traits like some diseases could be edited.

twist.text: Even if possible, unequal access would create genetic classes: enhanced kids for the rich, natural for the rest.

climax.text: Bioethicists warn that the line between curing disease and enhancing traits is blurry and could shift over time.

punchline.text: Designer babies are science fiction today but not forever.

quiz.question: Why is editing for traits like height or intelligence currently impractical?
options: Those traits involve thousands of genes
